name: elevenlabs
summary: Successfully completed the ElevenLabs quickstart end-to-end. Installed the elevenlabs and python-dotenv packages, created the example.py script, and ran it. The API call to text_to_speech.convert() succeeded and generated a valid MP3 audio file (output.mp3, 43,511 bytes, MPEG ADTS layer III, 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz, monaural).
deviations: The quickstart example uses `play(audio)` to play audio through speakers. Since the sandbox has no audio output hardware, I saved the returned audio stream to a file (`output.mp3`) instead. The core API request and TTS generation followed the docs exactly.

first_call.evidence: python example.py exited 0 and printed "Audio saved to output.mp3"

verified.evidence: file output.mp3 reported "Audio file with ID3 version 2.4.0, contains: MPEG ADTS, layer III, v1, 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz, Monaural"
